decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed demolition of the existing office accommodation would result in a loss of employment premises, contrary to policy E 1.5 of the Unitary Development Plan.
2.	The proposed creation of 127 flats and a large retail unit  outside the town centre is considered to be an overdevelopment of this site, resulting in inadequate accommodation for future occupiers,  and an excessive residential density, contrary to policy 4B.3 of the London Plan and policies ENV-B 1.1, ENV-B 1.8, H 1.1, H 4.1, H 4.2, H 5.1, T 1.1, T 1.4 and T 4.3 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.
3.	The proposed development, by virtue of its shape, form, massing and location would not be compatible with or enhance the character of the area in terms of size, scale and design, and does not achieve a building of outstanding architectural and urban design contrary to Policy ENV-B 1.1 New Development of the Unitary Development Plan, and the advice given in PPG 1 (General Policy and Principles) and the London Plan 
4.  	The proposed development would not preserve and enhance the character or appearance of the surrounding Thorney Hedge Conservation Area and nearby Wellesley Road Conservation Area contrary to Policy ENV B-2.2 of the Unitary Development Plan.
5.  	The proposed development fails to makes provision for a sufficient level and appropriate mix of affordable housing, contrary to policies 3A.7 and 3A.8 of the London Plan and Policy H.2.1 of the Unitary Development Plan.
6.  	The proposed development will result in the loss of residential amenity to nearby residential properties, through loss of outlook, loss of light, loss of privacy, overshadowing and general increased noise and disturbance from the increased number of people and vehicles using the site, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, ENV-B 1.2, H 4.1, H 4.2 and T 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan.

description: Demolition of existing office building and car showroom and erection of 12 storey building with front and rear balconies.  The ground floor will contain 605m2 retail, with 10 surface parking spaces, storeys 2-12 will contain 127 flats (75 x 1 bed, 41 x 2 bed, 11 x 3 bed) of which 45 will be affordable (34x1 bed & 11x 2 bed) 70 parking spaces are proposed below ground to the rear with access off Thorney Hedge Road.  A raised amenity area of 1045m2 is proposed at the rear above this parking.
